_comment: Independent B103 trap.c:blow_up_landmine route. On a debug Valkyrie at level 7, wish and wear water-walking boots, turn the starting floor tile into a moat, move east onto adjacent dry floor, wish a trapped land mine there, then step west and re-enter it. This tests the source path that calls fillholetyp and liquid_flow when the mine trap remains. The moat is a single neighbor, so fillholetyp can still choose ROOM; that outcome is a preserved setup result, not liquid-flow evidence.
